matches.role: Primary agent-definition parser and persistence implementation
matches.structure: Defines AgentDefinition and ParseAgentDefinitionOptions; validates structured LLM output with AGENT_DEFINITION_SCHEMA; parseAgentDefinition trims and validates input, obtains a tiered LLM, invokes it with SYSTEM_PROMPT, normalizes fields with removeDuplicates, persists via saveAgentDefinition, and returns the definition. saveAgentDefinition creates AppData/agents/<sanitized-agent-name> and writes <sanitized-agent-name>.json using Tauri filesystem APIs; sanitizeFolderName and removeDuplicates are private helpers.

relatedFiles.evidence: Imports parseAgentDefinition and calls it with the complete userRequest when the create_agent tool runs; formats the returned AgentDefinition into the tool response.
Re-exports parseAgentDefinition and AgentDefinition from this module for the chat/agent public surface.

relatedFiles.relationship: direct shared data-contract consumer and indirect persistence consumer
relatedFiles.evidence: Imports AgentDefinition as a type and scans AppData/agents JSON files using the same documented agents/<agent-name>/<agent-name>.json layout produced by saveAgentDefinition; maps persisted fields into AvailableAgent.
The target imports getAsyncLLM and LlmTier; parseAgentDefinition uses getAsyncLLM(options.tier ?? 'cheap', { temperature: 0 }) before structured invocation.
Imports createAgentTool and includes it in the main agent tool setup, making the parser reachable through the main chat agent.
Imports createAgentTool in the step workflow tool setup, so the parser is also reachable from that workflow path.
Imports AgentDefinition type and writes updates to an agent.path discovered by agent-loader; changes to the definition contract or persisted field semantics can affect this management path.
Uses agent-loader lookup/list operations and updates saved agent tool references, relying on the persisted definition shape produced by the target.
Imports runAgentByName; scheduled execution resolves saved agents through the loader, which reads files written by the target.
Grants fs:allow-exists, fs:allow-mkdir, and fs:allow-write-text-file, the Tauri filesystem capabilities used by saveAgentDefinition.
Defines npm run build as tsc && vite build and lists zod, Tauri APIs, and LangChain dependencies used by the target or its runtime path.
Includes src, uses strict TypeScript and noEmit; the target is typechecked as part of npm run build.

filesToRebuildOrUpdate.reason: Confirmed implementation location: a change to parsing prompts, schema, normalization, persistence layout, or exported AgentDefinition behavior requires editing this file.

changeImpact.summary: The target is the single implementation of agent-definition parsing and saving. Its runtime path is create_agent -> parseAgentDefinition -> getAsyncLLM/structured schema -> Tauri AppData persistence -> agent-loader discovery, with additional consumers of the AgentDefinition contract and saved JSON. Ordinary frontend validation/build is npm run build (tsc && vite build), but the verified current build is already failing on unrelated pre-existing TypeScript errors in other files (including Mocu.tsx, MCP tests, memory modules, AI tools, and store.ts); no failure was reported from the target file. Updating the exported contract or persisted field/layout would require reviewing the confirmed direct consumers and loader/management paths; a self-contained implementation edit ordinarily requires only rebuilding, not editing those consumers.
